title: wss: §6.1 TLS paraphrase drops BCP 195 and misscopes SHOULD
description: RFC 8887 §5.1: 'MUST use TLS 1.2 or later, following the recommendations in BCP 195 [RFC7525]. Servers SHOULD support TLS 1.3 or later.' draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 §6.1 paraphrase drops 'following the recommendations in BCP 195 [RFC7525]' entirely, and changes 'Servers SHOULD' to the unqualified 'TLS 1.3 or later is RECOMMENDED', removing the server-only scope. Fix: either quote RFC 8887 §5.1 verbatim or reproduce both missing details.
close_reason: Restored BCP 195 (RFC7525) citation dropped from RFC 8887 §5.1 paraphrase; restored 'Servers SHOULD' scoping for TLS 1.3 requirement. Added RFC7525 to informative references.
